messages:
Leah: Heads-up — CI flake from onboarding tests. Node SDK in our tests failed auth in GH Actions but passed locally for the same env vars. Anyone seen env-precedence issues across SDKs?
Tom: Noticed similar last week. Node SDK still supports legacy alias REDWOOD_KEY before REDWOOD_API_KEY; Python and Go prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY only. That mismatch can change which key is used when both are set by CI templates.
Ibrahim: Oof. Our actions templates set REDWOOD_KEY for historical reasons, but local dev quickstart sets REDWOOD_API_KEY. New hire copied quickstart -> worked locally -> CI used REDWOOD_KEY -> different org/project bound key -> 403.
QA: Repro steps I used:
```
# GH Actions env (examples)
REDWOOD_KEY=pk_legacy_abc
REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_new_xyz
# Node prefers legacy here -> uses pk_legacy_abc which is org-scoped
# Python prefers pk_new_xyz -> project-scoped
npm test -> fails in CI with 403
python -m pytest -> passes
```
Leah: The confusing part: both keys are valid but different scopes. CI templates also inject REDWOOD_ORG which led to implicit binding mismatch.
Tom: Two issues: env var precedence parity across SDKs, and our SDK retry behavior for 401s. Node SDK currently retries automatically on transient network errors but does not surface when retry was due to auth header mismatch vs rotation. That makes debugging hard.
Ibrahim: Also saw a bug where retry path reused an old cached token after a 401, so repeated retries kept failing. Reproducer in Node: start long poll, rotate binding server-side, client receives first 401, retry loop runs but still sends cached header.
Leah: Proposed plan:
- Short term: update GH Actions templates to use only REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a comment about scope.
- Medium: add cross-SDK spec: env precedence order MUST be REDWOOD_API_KEY then legacy alias if absent; publish and add tests in infra.
- SDK fix: on 401, clear auth cache and surface a specific error message: "Auth failed: possible key scope mismatch or rotated key. Check REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY and REDWOOD_ORG/REDWOOD_PROJECT."
QA: Also suggest adding a lightweight debug CLI command `redwood debug-creds` that prints which env var would be used and non-sensitive scope (org/project) so users don't have to guess.
Tom: I'll open PRs: node SDK env precedence change + unit tests, and a small SDK change to clear cached header on 401 before retrying once. Also add a log line when legacy alias used.
Ibrahim: I'll add an e2e job that runs sampleapp in GH Actions with only REDWOOD_API_KEY to catch regressions. Also add a lint that flags use of REDWOOD_KEY in templates.
opsbot: Created ticket INF-6123: "SDK env precedence parity + 401 retry cache bug" at 3412345689.
Leah: Nice. Can we also add a short section to onboarding quickstart: table of env var precedence across SDKs and recommended CI pattern (use REDWOOD_API_KEY only)? New hires keep getting stuck.
Tom: Will include quickstart change in PR and link to INF-6123. PR: https://git.example/redwood/node-sdk/pull/278
Ibrahim: FYI privacy sign-off required for any telemetry change. We'll only emit non-identifying metric on 401-with-scope if approved.
Leah: Thanks all — feel free to tag me when PRs are ready, I'll shepherd the docs update.
